about: [O5b] the board in HQ's hall and the desk (brief O5b §2): the first man on the board put on a corner of the headquarters' street (a tool's move: the walk to his corner is not the contest), beaten by O4's good brawl bot and taken in ('Come on.'); he follows me by real input along the pavement, in at the street door behind me, to the sergeant's desk: E 'book him' - 'Book him.', the reward through game.money, game.things.end, the poster on the hall's sheet PAID, the outside board gone; he is walked to a cell.

steps.eval: (() => { N.controller.pitch = 0; const B = G.night.bounty, b = B.names()[0]; const s = G.city.places.byId.get('police'), d = s.door, tx = -d.nz, tz = d.nx; b.x = +(d.x + d.nx * 2.2 + tx * 16).toFixed(1); b.z = +(d.z + d.nz * 2.2 + tz * 16).toFixed(1); const M = B.men.get('b0'); if (M) { B.drop(M); B.men.delete('b0'); } b.state = 'out'; b.awayT = null; window.__hq = { x: d.x, z: d.z, nx: d.nx, nz: d.nz }; return [b.name, b.x, b.z, d.x, d.z, d.nx, d.nz]; })()

steps.label: good hands: beaten and taken in

steps.walk: (() => { const h = window.__hq; return [[h.x + h.nx * 2.2 - h.nz * 6, h.z + h.nz * 2.2 + h.nx * 6], [h.x + h.nx * 2.0, h.z + h.nz * 2.0]]; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const M = G.night.bounty.men.get('b0'), e = N.controller.pos; return 'he is ' + Math.hypot(M.c.pos.x - e.x, M.c.pos.z - e.z).toFixed(1) + ' m behind, ' + M.walk; })()

steps.walk: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('police'), F = s.frame; return [[0, -0.2], [0, -2.0], [0, -3.9]].map(([x, z]) => { const p = F.w(x, z); return [p.x, p.z]; }); })()

steps.label: at the desk with him at my side: 'book him'

steps.name: booked: the reward, the thing put down
steps.expect: G.save.money === window.__m0 + 150 && G.night.bounty.names()[0].state === 'paid' && G.save.flags.night && G.save.flags.night.bounty_b0 && G.save.flags.night.bounty_b0.result === 'booked'

steps.name: the poster on the hall's sheet redrawn PAID
steps.expect: (() => { const K = G.city.places.byId.get('police').live.K; return !!K.group.getObjectByName('poster b0') && G.night.bounty.names()[0].state === 'paid'; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('police'), F = s.frame, p = F.w(s.live.K.bounty.x, -1.6); const C = N.controller; C.setPose(p.x, p.z, F.yaw(0) + Math.PI, 0.12, 0.3); return 1; })()

steps.label: walked through the cells' door to a cell

steps.eval: (() => { const M = G.night.bounty.men.get('b0'), s = G.city.places.byId.get('police'), p = s.frame.l(M.c.pos.x, M.c.pos.z); return 'in the cell at ' + p.x.toFixed(1) + ',' + p.z.toFixed(1); })()
